key_insight: AI can unify instability research on all-inorganic CsPbX3 perovskites by linking diagnosis, mechanism discovery, reliability prediction, and stability engineering into one practical framework.
engineering_relevance: This enables faster design of more durable perovskite solar cells and related optoelectronic devices under thermal, chemical, optical, and electrical stress.
evidence_signal: The review notes that AI is especially valuable because conventional studies struggle with multimodal data, coupled degradation pathways, protocol dependence, sparse statistics, and uncertainty quantification.
watch_item: Current AI methods remain limited by data quality, inconsistent protocols, weak benchmarks, and poor transferability across domains.
paper_title: Artificial Intelligence for Instability in Inorganic Perovskites: From Mechanism Discovery to Engineering Strategies
